map.输入供试种子数及逐日发芽数，计算发芽率、发芽势、发芽指数(GI)与活力指数(VI: Enter test seed count and daily germination to compute germination rate, energy, index (GI), and vigor index (VI)
map.📖 查看「种子发芽率与活力指数计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Seed Germination and Vigor Index Calculator Guide"
map.发芽率 = 发芽总数 ÷ 供试种子数 × 100%；发芽势 = 前 n 天发芽数: Germination rate = total germinated / test seeds x 100%; germination energy = n-day germinated / test seeds x 100%; GI = sum(daily germinated / day); VI = GI x mean seedling length
map.发芽率反映最终出苗能力；发芽势取前 n 天（通常 3~4 天）累积发芽占比，反映: Germination rate shows final emergence ability; germination energy takes the first n days (usually 3-4) cumulative share, reflecting uniformity and speed; GI weights daily germination by the reciprocal of day (earlier higher); VI = GI x seedling length combines speed and growth. Rate >=90% premium, >=80% qualified, >=70% marginal, else unqualified.
map.📚 深度解析：种子发芽率与活力指数计算器: 📚 Deep Dive: Seed Germination and Vigor Index Calculator
map.发芽率 = 发芽种子数 / 供试种子数 × 100%。: Germination rate = germinated seeds / test seeds x 100%.
map.活力指数 VI = 发芽率 × 幼苗平均鲜重或苗长。: Vigor index VI = germination rate x mean seedling fresh weight or length.
map.用于播前种子质量检验与播量校正。: Used for pre-sowing seed quality test and sowing-rate correction.
map.100 粒供试 7 天发芽 92 粒，发芽率 92%。平均苗长 12 cm，活力: 100 seeds tested, 92 germinated in 7 days, rate 92%. Mean length 12 cm, VI = 0.92 x 12 = 11.04. If rate only 80%, raise sowing rate (divide by 0.80) to compensate.
map.发芽率和活力指数区别？: Difference between germination rate and vigor index?
map.发芽率只看『出不出』，活力指数还看『出的壮不壮』（苗长/重），更能预测田间出苗整: Rate only sees "whether it emerges"; vigor also sees "how strong" (length/weight), better predicting field uniformity and strong-seedling rate.
map.提高播量按发芽率折算（目标苗数÷发芽率），或选高活力批次。低于国标良种标准的种子: Raise sowing rate by germination (target seedlings / rate), or pick a high-vigor batch. Seeds below national good-seed standard are not advised for fields.
